step_name: Final snapshot of on-premise servers
notes: Snapshot all VMs before migration begins

step_name: Validate Azure landing zone readiness
notes: VNet

step_name: Confirm Azure AD sync is working correctly
notes: All user accounts synced and tested

step_name: Notify all users of maintenance window
notes: Email sent 24 hours and 1 hour before cutover

step_name: Put on-premise systems into maintenance mode
notes: Prevent new connections during migration

step_name: Migrate workload 1 — file server to Azure Files
notes: Azure File Sync used — validate file counts after

step_name: Migrate workload 2 — application servers to Azure VMs
notes: Lift and shift — validate application startup after migration

step_name: Migrate workload 3 — database to Azure SQL
notes: Full database migration — no rollback once data is in Azure SQL

step_name: Validate database integrity post migration
notes: Row counts

step_name: Update DNS records to point to Azure endpoints
notes: TTL set to 5 minutes — monitor propagation

step_name: Update firewall rules and NSG policies
notes: Allow only required ports and IP ranges

step_name: Smoke test — application connectivity from Azure
notes: End-to-end test of all critical application paths

step_name: Enable user access to Azure-hosted systems
notes: Phased — IT first

step_name: Full application regression test
notes: All critical business processes tested

step_name: Performance baseline — Azure vs on-premise
notes: Response times and throughput compared against baseline

step_name: Security scan — Azure environment
notes: Vulnerability scan of all migrated workloads

step_name: Cost baseline — confirm Azure spend is within budget
notes: Check Azure Cost Management dashboard

step_name: Decommission on-premise servers
notes: Only after 5 days of stable Azure operation

step_name: Update runbooks and IT documentation
notes: All operational procedures updated for Azure environment

step_name: Hypercare period begins — Azure support monitoring
notes: Enhanced monitoring for first 2 weeks post migration
